'''Brian Quan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 San Francisco tournament]] on 5 August 2000 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC Speed Setup and Drains]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1095">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-san-francisco-ca-9-5d1095/ san-francisco-ca-9-5], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 7 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-san-francisco-ca-9-5d1095/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
